item.title: Branko Kolarevic, digital design scholar and NJIT dean, dies at 62
item.description: Architect, researcher, and educator Branko Kolarevic, former dean of the Hillier College of Architecture and Design at the New Jersey Institute of Technology (NJIT), passed away on January 29, 2026. Archinect previously covered his appointment as dean in 2019. item.title: Disenchanted London and Hawksmoor’s architecture of terror and magnificence
item.description: At the southern end, I take an elevator and find myself in Greenwich, surrounded by tourists. After the sepulchral silence of the Isle of Dogs, it’s a shock. I walk across a sort of piazza, under the tall masts of the clipper ship Cutty Sark. The last of the Hawksmoor churches is just around the corner. item.title: NASA Glenn Research Support Building by Bialosky
item.description: Inspired by space exploration and satellites, the floating linear building is a sustainable, collaborative hub at the heart of the NASA Glenn Research Center, a facility that designs and develops innovative technology to advance NASA’s missions in aeronautics and space exploration. The LEED Gold project recenters and reconnects the campus with shared resources for the research center and NASA at large. item.title: Brooklyn Branch, Cuyahoga County Public Library by Bialosky
item.description: The new Brooklyn Branch of the Cuyahoga County Public Library emerges as a luminous civic anchor within Brooklyn's municipal campus. The dynamic 25,000-square-foot pavilion exemplifies the contemporary library experience as media-rich, technologically innovative, and socially engaging. Structured around a central organizing spine, the pavilion-like interior unfolds through strategic sight lines and flexible spaces anchored by a welcoming hearth. item.title: Nimis Middle School by ATI Project
item.description: Contemporary volumes for a sustainable school The project for the secondary school in Nimis completes the school campus of the city. The exterior spaces have a special relation with the building that is configured as a compact volume. The circulation areas are conceived as hybrid zones, at times envisaged as gathering areas and at times as spaces for extra-curricular activities. item.title: 78 architects elevated to AIA College of Fellows
item.description: The American Institute of Architects named 78 members to the AIA College of Fellows today, honoring significant contributions to the profession. Eligible candidates, each with at least 10 years of AIA membership, were recognized for advancing design excellence, professional standards, education, and architecture’s impact on society.
